faq.q: Is White Rock part of Surrey?
faq.a: No. White Rock is its own city with its own council, zoning bylaw and planning rules, while Crescent Beach and Ocean Park are part of the City of Surrey — which is why this page's scope crosses two different rulebooks.

faq.q: Can Jared show me homes in Luxury?
faq.a: Yes. Jared Gibbons, REALTOR® with Royal LePage Little Oak Realty, books private showings across the Fraser Valley and Metro Vancouver. Call or text 604-928-1361, or use the contact form on this site.
